ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Curl File Upload - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious curl process start the adds a file to a web request

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/curl$") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-form.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-upload\\-file\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-data\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-data\\-.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX("\s-[FTd]\s"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/localhost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1.*")))
